verses.text: The LORD said to Moses,
"Speak to the people of Israel and tell them: I am the LORD your God.
Do not live the way people do in Egypt, where you used to live. Do not live the way people do in Canaan, where I am bringing you. Do not follow their customs.
Obey my laws and carefully follow my rules. I am the LORD your God.
Keep my rules and my laws. The person who obeys them will find life through them. I am the LORD.
None of you may come near a close relative to have sexual relations. I am the LORD.
Do not dishonour your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother. Do not have sexual relations with her.
Do not have sexual relations with your father's wife. That would dishonour your father.
Do not have sexual relations with your sister, whether she is your father's daughter or your mother's daughter, and whether she was born in your home or somewhere else.
Do not have sexual relations with your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter. That would dishonour you.
Do not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father's wife, born to your father. She is your sister.
Do not have sexual relations with your father's sister. She is your father's close relative.
Do not have sexual relations with your mother's sister. She is your mother's close relative.
Do not dishonour your father's brother by going near his wife for sexual relations. She is your aunt.
Do not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son's wife. Do not have sexual relations with her.
Do not have sexual relations with your brother's wife. That would dishonour your brother.
Do not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. Do not take her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter for sexual relations. They are her close relatives. That is evil.
Do not marry your wife's sister while your wife is still alive, to be her rival and to have sexual relations with her.
Do not go near a woman for sexual relations during her monthly period, while she is unclean.
Do not have sexual relations with your neighbour's wife and make yourself unclean with her.
Do not give any of your children to be sacrificed to the god Molech. Do not dishonour the name of your God. I am the LORD.
Do not have sexual relations with a man as one does with a woman. That is disgusting.
Do not have sexual relations with any animal and make yourself unclean with it. A woman must not give herself to an animal to have sexual relations with it. That is a terrible perversion.
Do not make yourselves unclean in any of these ways. That is how the nations I am driving out ahead of you made themselves unclean.
Even the land became unclean, so I punished it for its sin, and the land threw out the people living in it, like someone vomiting.
But you must keep my rules and laws. You must not do any of these disgusting things, whether you were born in the land or are a foreigner living among you.
The people who lived in the land before you did all these disgusting things, and the land became unclean.
If you make the land unclean, it will throw you out too, just as it threw out the nation that was there before you.
Anyone who does any of these disgusting things must be cut off from his people.
So keep my commands, and do not follow any of the disgusting customs that were practised before you came. Do not make yourselves unclean with them. I am the LORD your God."
